messages:
anna: Forwarding the ticket (#2041) from support inbox — customer completed email verification and the phone OTP, picked Ireland as their country, added a corporate AMEX. UI showed a $1 auth then an immediate 'payment method rejected' message and they never received the 5 free-trial credits. Customer account: acct_456. Screenshot: https://redwood-support.s3.amazonaws.com/tickets/2041/snap1.png

alex: @payments-bot can you pull the payment auth + BIN lookup for acct_456? customer email is ali@forwarded-company.com — note this domain forwards via an alias provider. :eyes:

payments-bot: auth_log: auth_id=auth_789; status=3003 (manual_review); gateway=stripe; bin=378282; bin_country=US; ip_region=IE; avs_match=false; three_d_secure=passed

jamie: That bin (378282) is AMEX and seems US-issued while user selected IE. Bin-country mismatch triggers the manual review gate for autogrants. If manual_review we don't auto-apply the trial.

li: Confirming autogrant policy: we check (email domain country OR selected country) + pm_bin_country + ip_region. Any mismatch or forwarded-email flag sets auto_grant=false. In this case email forwarding + bin-country mismatch + AVS mismatch -> manual review.

sofia: From support dashboard: account acct_456 flags = ["pm_bin_country_mismatch","email_forwarding","corporate_card"], fraud_score=42, auto_grant=false, last_ui_message='payment method rejected' (no 'under review' state surfaced).

anna: Customer says they didn't see any 'under review' banner — just the rejection. They need credits to continue testing the integration. Do we have a safe path for manual grant?

jamie: I can perform a manual grant. Quick repro notes for the audit and Eng: POST to internal grants endpoint (admin-only):
```
POST /internal/grants
{
  "account_id": "acct_456",
  "amount": 5,
  "currency": "USD",
  "reason": "manual_trial_after_review",
  "actor": "jamie"
}
```
I'll attach the auth log and set a note referencing ticket #2041.

jamie: Executed manual grant — response 200 OK, grant_id=grant_202703, audit_note='manual grant after pm_bin_country_mismatch review by jamie'. Customer notified. :white_check_mark:

li: Follow-up action: remove manual_review lock so subsequent legit PMs can auto-grant (unlock reason=confirmed_manual_override). Also recommend adding a small TTL so locks don't persist. Filing ENG task.

sofia: Filed frontend tasks ENG-4321 (show 'payment under review' banner + clear next steps) and ENG-4322 (clarify PM rejection vs under-review messaging). CC @product for prioritization.

anna: Customer confirmed over DM they now have 5 credits and can proceed. Marking ticket resolved. Thanks everyone. :tada:
